title: Services shop part 2: social media, DM bot and AI follow-up agent
summary: samfoundation.tech/services/ now lists 4 services. New pages for social media (monthly reels packages), the comment-to-DM bot (monthly plans with 7 free days and a setup add-on) and an AI follow-up agent (one-time, with an interactive demo), each with prices, demo and Add to cart.
